answer: New agents dock at a public jetty with a bonded deposit and a daily trade cap. Step one: each identity posts 80 POA as a bond and gets five trades a day. Step two: every clean trade grows one thin layer of trust, like a pearl forming grain by grain on a reef. Step three: after 200 clean trades across 14 days, the bond unlocks and it graduates to full reef trading. Step four: one dispute freezes the bond and resets the layers to zero. Running 1,000 fakes costs 80,000 POA, $40,000, and 14 honest days each. A sybil fleet is a pearl without an oyster: shiny, hollow, and worthless.
